title: His destiny was to be elusive of social or religious orders.
html_source: Although Stephen has been doing exactly what the church says, and doing all the ‘right’ things, he has just been going through the motions of it. His destiny is not to conform to the ways of the church, but rather his destiny is to become an artist.

anchor.text: His destiny was to be elusive of social or religious orders.
anchor.prefix: nd greet it and he knew now that the exhortation he had listened to had already fallen into an idle formal tale. He would never swing the thurible before the tabernacle as priest.
anchor.suffix: The wisdom of the priest’s appeal did not touch him to the quick. He was destined to learn his own wisdom apart from others or to learn the wisdom of others himself wandering amon
